input.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/pptest && cat > /tmp/pptest/t.py <<'EOF'
import sys, copy, torch, torch.distributed as dist
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-06ft2w78/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_3nnu9b3k")
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
dist.init_process_group("gloo"); r=dist.get_rank()
torch.manual_seed(0)
cfg=LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128,hidden_size=64,intermediate_size=128,num_hidden_layers=5,num_attention_heads=4,num_key_value_heads=2)
m=LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref=copy.deepcopy(m)
inp=[torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(3)]; tgt=[torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(3)]
calls={}
for i,l in enumerate(m.model.layers): l.register_forward_hook(lambda mod,a,o,i=i: calls.__setitem__(i,calls.get(i,0)+1))
loss=train_step_pipeline_afab(m,inp,tgt,torch.device("cpu"),torch.float32)
rl=0
for x,y in zip(inp,tgt):
    lg=ref(x).logits; l=torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(lg.view(-1,128),y.view(-1))/3; l.backward(); rl+=l.item()
print(r,"layers",calls,"loss",loss, rl)
mx=0
for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(m.named_parameters(),ref.named_parameters()):
    if p.grad is not None: mx=max(mx,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
print(r,"maxdiff",mx, sum(p.grad is not None for p in m.parameters()))
dist.destroy_process_group()
EOF
cd /tmp/pptest && torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 t.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn; torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 t.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn
